stem: Larkspur Robotics is writing a variable `validation` condition and needs a plain true/false result indicating whether `regex()` would succeed against the input, without needing the matched value itself. Which function fits?
rationale: can evaluates an expression and returns a boolean indicating whether it produced a result without error -- exactly the true/false a validation condition needs. try instead returns the actual result of the first expression that doesn't error, a fallback value rather than a boolean, so it's the wrong shape here. lookup and merge are map-handling functions with nothing to do with catching an expression error.
